name: Blazingstar mentzelia
desc: Blazingstar mentzelia (Mentzelia laevicaulis): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 136 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Mentzelia laevicaulis is a showy biennial or short-lived perennial wildflower native to western North America. Its common names include giant blazingstar and smoothstem blazingstar.
